The merge arithmetic in step 2 is wrong: the script computes `tmp = base + λ(ft1 - base)` and then `out = tmp + λ(ft2 - tmp)`, taking the second task vector against the already-merged tensor instead of against the unmodified base. This expands to `0.36*base + 0.24*ft1 + 0.40*ft2`, whereas the specified formula `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)` gives `0.20*base + 0.40*ft1 + 0.40*ft2`. This is precisely the ordering hazard the specification calls out, and it violates the "Required result" clause 2; the ft1 coefficient is off by 0.16, far beyond the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance. The rest of the script (name-set and shared-tensor verification, float32 computation with cast back to float16, the 64-merged and 244-tensor assertions, single output file) matches the specification.
